avis.titre: Work well! Not a huge difference between the daytime and nighttime though
avis.texte: I've been trying out a ton of pimple patches lately and got both the day time and night time version of these patches to compare! I wouldn't say either one is more or less effective, just that the daytime ones are little more sheer and have more of a transition from the edge of the patch to the center of the path so that it blends in better with you skin. In contrast, the night time patches are thicker with little to no change in thickness from the edge to the center. Since they are thicker, they are less sheer and a bit more noticeable on the skin. These definitely do help to flatten blemishes and reduce redness a bit. I don't think you can ever really expect a pimple patch to magically make a pimple disappear, but these do help more than leaving it alone would (in my experience)! They serve the extra benefit of keeping me from picking at my skin as well, which is always a plus. My only complaint is that there is almost no possible way to pick up the patch without touching the sticky side. This always worries me because it is introducing dirt or germs (even though I of course wash my hands first) to the underside of the patch that is then adhered to your skin. I MUCH prefer patches that have a tab on the side or top that you use to peel up the patch from the plastic sheet, so that you never have to contaminate the patch part. For that reason alone, I don't plan to repurchase these since I know I can get some that work similarly and have the little tab that keeps you from com

avis.titre: They stick well, get gunk out, and help heal fasterThey stick well, get gunk out, and help heal faster
avis.texte: These patches seem to work for me for multiple reasons. First, they do pull gunk out of my pimples, but only if they’re whiteheads or “open” blemishes. If the pimple is deeper, these won’t do anything. Second, they do seem to help speed up the disappearance of my blemishes. I’ll still have the blemish after removing the patch, but it’s less noticeable than if I didn’t use the patch. Lastly, they prevent me from picking at my acne, which is a huge issue for me and always prolongs the problem. By not being able to pick at the blemish, that helps it heal faster. These stick to my face well, and I haven’t had any issues with them sliding around or coming off. I do avoid putting lotion where I’ll be using a patch, which I think helps them stick better. They also don’t leave much of a sticky residue on my skin. The different sizes of these are nice, because I don’t like having to put a big patch over a small pimple. They’re a light, somewhat see-through color that blends in well with my fairly pale skin. They also have an expiration date that’s a little over two years out.

I'm a fan of these things. They're good for sucking all the moisture and oil from the skin. I used this multiple purposes from pimples to ingrown hairs and it's painless. I also like that it's transparent.

I am in my late 40's with dry, sensitive skin that breaks out just thinking about it, and four daughters in the tween and teen range. We get a lot of zits. Patches like these couldn't be easier to use. Simply put one on the offending spot, go to bed, and wake up in the morning with the liquid pulled out. Make sure skin is dry and doesn't have lotion on it for better sticking. Some people will wear them during the day but the patches turn white when the gunk is pulled out and I find that hard to ignore. These patches are boxed with three sleeves, wax paper on one side and plastic on the other. They peel open, leaving the other two sleeves fresh until needed. There are three sizes included . . . the smallest is perfect for whiteheads but the largest is still too small for my cystic acne. The plastic they are on is perforated so they are easy to remove from the backing without rolling and wasting the dot. These stick nicely to my skin and don't hurt or leave a residue when I remove them. They are thicker than the standard sticker. Made in Korea

Patches stick well and appreciate the variety of sizes, as not all pimples are the same size! Unfortunately, the product doesn't actually surface or pull away any pimples. They are still there in the mornings.

avis.titre: Great patches to calm monster pimples
avis.texte: These are great to keep on hand for bedtime and after traveling. I am always suffering from a giant, swollen pimple popping up somewhere so these things are a godsend. I got these bedtime ones as well as the daytime ASAP patches. These ones are definitely thicker and more noticeable, but comfortable. These ones work great and are easy to apply. They quickly go to work drawing out excess inflammation fluid from your monster zits. I swear they cut healing time in half. Keep the areas clean obviously.

avis.titre: A GOOD ACNE/PIMPLE REMOVER THAT USES HYDROCOLLOID INSTEAD OF SALASYLIC ACID, WORKS WELL
avis.texte: They work great, no issues pretty much like other acne pimple sheets i have purchased. The only difference is that it doesnt use salicylic acid. Instead it uses Hydrocolloid, which is think is less harmful to the skin. It uses Niacin as well. They peel of the sheets easy and I like the fact that it is not tested on animals. It states to leave it on fur 7 to 12 hours, or until it turns into an opaque color. I have oily skin as does my daughter, so they were good for us. I used them and my daughter, both at night with good results. The price could be better though, fir the amount you recieve, that's why I'm giving 4 stars instead of 5.

I've tried many a hydrocolloid patch in my attempts to prevent overnight picking and to calm my hormonal acne. So far, this set by glowiest is decent but not my favorite. I am surprised, however, that some of the patches I've applied have pulled gunk directly from my whiteheads overnight! The good: - split backing that has clicky separation, allowing you to peel down the backing column only as much as is needed to gently grab your patch. This helps avoid curled patch edges - three different sizes - hydrocolloid and niacinamide - hasn't caused any negative reactions to my sensitive skin - pulls some gunk out of whiteheads! The "meh": - Material feels a little thicker than other brands I've tried (maybe due to the overnight intended use?). More noticeable when on, slight tape sensation (might aggravate sensory issues) - Size layout on sheet is a little odd, you have to peel down some of the center columns to access larger size - Don't sit as flush to skin, not as discreet - not as budget friendly as some brands for the quantity Overall, I'm hopeful that these will help tackle little flare-ups. I'd give this set a 3.5/5 if possible. I'll update this review if needed with more use. Update: 4/5 to 3/5. These don't stay adhered very well and lift throughout the night.

Can’t wait to try these. Even as an adult, I have the occasional breakout and when I do they are usually pretty bad. I have always put lotions and potions on at night. When it comes to blemishes, I usually put a dallop of whatever my potion of choice is, but you know it ends up on the pillow, in my hair or on my cat (whoops!). I really like that this is a patch that will secure the topical to my skin. Not only does that mean the treatment will last through the night, it also means I won’t have to clean up any messes.

I always found these type of patches so interesting. Put it on before you got to sleep and wake up to see what these pull up. I have noticed other brands to work faster but these do the job too. I like that it comes with different sized ones and that they are clear. I tend to pop and pick at my face if I feel a bump so these have helped me stop that habit.

My daughter has tried numerous acne patches but she swears by these ASAP. These patches have a strong adhesion, conveniently comes in three different sizes and blends seamlessly with her skin. They work effectively FAST to eradicate her pimples basically overnight. There’s definitely a noticeable improvement with inflammation & redness reduction the following morning. These ASAP Overnight patches really work as intended so we definitely recommend!

Great pimple patches! It comes with three different sizes so you can use the size that works best for your breakout. They stayed on well, I didn’t have any issues with the sides lifting up. Great value for the price - helps me to not touch my face as much!
These are very comfortable to wear, you can't even feel them. I will use them overnight and they definitely pull out whatever is going on in your skin and heals up nicely
